# Error Reference

## Error codes

| Code | Recoverability | Mechanical response |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND`](workspace-not-found/) | usually recoverable | Select or register a canonical workspace. |
| [`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`](resource-not-found/) | usually recoverable | Resolve the canonical resource again. |
| [`AMBIGUOUS_RESOURCE`](ambiguous-resource/) | usually recoverable | Provide an explicit canonical reference. |
| [`STUDIO_NOT_CONNECTED`](studio-not-connected/) | usually recoverable | Inspect Studio environment/session health and reconnect. |
| [`STUDIO_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE`](studio-capability-unavailable/) | usually recoverable | Use a provider/platform where the capability is available. |
| [`SOURCE_PARSE_FAILED`](source-parse-failed/) | usually recoverable | Inspect the source and parser diagnostics. |
| [`SOURCE_CHANGED`](source-changed/) | usually recoverable | Re-read the external source and reconcile the change. |
| [`REVISION_CONFLICT`](revision-conflict/) | usually recoverable | Re-read the external source and reconcile the change. |
| [`POLICY_DENIED`](policy-denied/) | usually recoverable | Request an allowed operation or change policy explicitly. |
| [`CHANGE_SET_INVALID`](change-set-invalid/) | usually recoverable | Correct the ChangeSet contract before retrying. |
| [`CHANGE_SET_CONFLICT`](change-set-conflict/) | usually recoverable | Refresh the target and resolve the conflicting revision. |
| [`CHANGE_SET_APPLY_FAILED`](change-set-apply-failed/) | usually recoverable | Inspect adapter evidence and retry only when safe. |
| [`ROLLBACK_FAILED`](rollback-failed/) | requires intervention | Stop and inspect the target state before further mutation. |
| [`RESULT_EXPIRED`](result-expired/) | usually recoverable | Re-run the operation to create a new result. |
| [`PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND`](provider-not-found/) | usually recoverable | Inspect the provider registry and use a current ProviderId. |
| [`PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`](provider-unavailable/) | usually recoverable | Reconnect the provider or select another explicit implementation. |
| [`PROVIDER_AUTH_REQUIRED`](provider-auth-required/) | usually recoverable | Configure the provider credential reference. |
| [`PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED`](provider-connection-failed/) | usually recoverable | Inspect transport diagnostics and retry with bounded backoff. |
| [`PROVIDER_DEGRADED`](provider-degraded/) | usually recoverable | Inspect health evidence before issuing expensive operations. |
| [`TOOL_NOT_FOUND`](tool-not-found/) | usually recoverable | Search the active catalog for a current ToolRef. |
| [`TOOL_UNAVAILABLE`](tool-unavailable/) | usually recoverable | Reconnect the provider or use a configured alternative. |
| [`TOOL_SCHEMA_INVALID`](tool-schema-invalid/) | usually recoverable | Quarantine the provider schema and inspect its catalog. |
| [`TOOL_SCHEMA_CHANGED`](tool-schema-changed/) | usually recoverable | Inspect the new SchemaRevision and validate inputs again. |
| [`CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND`](capability-not-found/) | usually recoverable | Use a validated versioned CapabilityId. |
| [`CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE`](capability-unavailable/) | usually recoverable | Connect a provider that explicitly implements the capability. |
| [`AMBIGUOUS_CAPABILITY`](ambiguous-capability/) | usually recoverable | Provide an explicit target or configured provider preference. |
| [`INPUT_SCHEMA_FAILED`](input-schema-failed/) | usually recoverable | Correct the arguments against the inspected schema. |
| [`OPERATION_TIMEOUT`](operation-timeout/) | usually recoverable | Inspect provider health; retry only when operation semantics allow it. |
| [`OPERATION_CANCELLED`](operation-cancelled/) | usually recoverable | Confirm provider cancellation state before retrying. |
| [`RESULT_TOO_LARGE`](result-too-large/) | usually recoverable | Read the bounded result reference instead of requesting inline content. |
| [`PROVIDER_PROTOCOL_ERROR`](provider-protocol-error/) | usually recoverable | Inspect negotiated protocol profile and provider diagnostics. |
| [`INTERNAL`](internal/) | requires intervention | Preserve the OperationId and inspect daemon logs. |
